test_cases.title: Percentage promo (20%): refund equals the discounted price paid
Fixed €10 promo is prorated across items for a partial refund
Refund never uses the list price for discounted items
Order with 100% discount: no €0.00 refund is created
test_cases.preconditions: Order fully covered by a 100% promo
test_cases.expected: No refund record created; customer told nothing is due

test_cases.title: Promo code is not reinstated after refund
steps: Try to use SAVE10 on a new order
test_cases.expected: Code is rejected as already used

test_cases.title: Prorated amounts are rounded to the cent
test_cases.expected: Refund has 2 decimals and all refunds add up to the amount paid

test_cases.title: Total refunds on a discounted order cannot exceed the amount paid
Refund confirmation shows the discount applied
test_cases.expected: Shows list price, discount and refunded amount

test_cases.title: Refund writes an audit log entry
test_cases.expected: Entry includes promo code and discount
